sourceAuthority.behavior: default33ms sampling; history eight vectors;99ms expiry
integer scroll threshold/throw direction and10percent decay
46px row pitch at factory font/theme geometry;200ms selection snap

coordinateSpace: 466x466 comparison coordinates; factory normalHAL pointer x is mapped to raw468wide coordinates by the explicit per-scene coordinateMapping/source-anchor contract (centered raw x = comparison x + 1). Screenshot crop alone is not a pointer mapping; record actual input coordinates and source anchors.
hardwareSafety: Only physically muted diagnostic builds; require independent mute clamp assertion before execution
comparisonPolicy: Same event recipe is insufficient unless actual sampling/timing and initial state match. Host transport delays must be retained; no screenshot command during gesture unless backend proves it does not block input processing.

factory.pointer: TOUCH 1 x y for down/move;TOUCH 0 x y for up
factory.trace: INPUTTRACE BEGIN/END;SWINPUT [timestamp_us,touchNum,x,y] sampled normal LVGL read_cb

gea.trace: GEADEV INPUTTRACE BEGIN/END;SWINPUT [timestamp_us,phase1down/2move/3up,touchNum,x,y,pointerId,handlerX,handlerY] consumed normal TouchRuntime event

diagnosticProtocols.samplingDifference: Factory trace samples indev at33ms; Gea trace records consumed dispatch events. Compare against actual helper/tick history evidence too; row-count equality is not required or evidence of failure.
